subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add normal-session max-age and max-turn automatic rotation, and what public config shape plus memory/continuity contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines new public lifecycle config and behavior for preserving session state across automatic resets.

options.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
options.body: Extend the core session reset policy with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

options.title: Fold into broader session-boundary design
options.body: Keep this as a requirement but implement it only with the broader session-boundary work tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/17217.

options.title: Defer automatic rotation
options.body: Document daily/idle/manual reset, context pruning, compaction, and external hygiene mitigations without adding new core lifecycle config for now.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Extend the core session reset policy with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the daily reset and memory-flush history that steipete introduced, not only a mechanical schema change.
